state_assignment: Manhattan distance to supplied empirical centers; state order is fixed
data_type: Real processed research data; no raw images, BOLD timeseries or clinical records
selection: Previously analyzed PTN example with complete model inputs and empirical state-1 FO below the HLC group mean. Illustrative selection, not representative sampling.
seed_note: Numeric seed base preserves the source run independently of the public example identifier. Repeat seed = seed_base + round(G * 100000) * 1000 + repeat_index.
state_centers_csv: state_centers.csv: human-readable export of the canonical 2x116 array in ptn_demo.npz; the simulator reads the NPZ array.
